subject: Line management consolidation: proposal & next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18 09:12 PST
Subject: Line management consolidation: proposal & ask

Team —

Following our leadership sync last week I sketched a proposal to consolidate line management for the Serving Runtime and Platform Observability squads under a single Director of Platform Engineering. The goal is to reduce cross-team coordination overhead, create clearer career paths for engineers doing infra work, and simplify on-call ownership.

High-level proposal (attached: line_management_matrix.xlsx, transition_playbook_v1.pdf):
- Move Serving Runtime (currently split across two managers) under Manager A -> Director Platform
- Move Observability infra (one manager) to same Director to centralize infra tooling cadence
- Consolidate on-call rotation into a single platform rota; retain service-level owners per-API

Risks I've flagged in the playbook:
- Manager spans temporarily increase during transition (2-3 months)
- Performance review timing overlaps with transition; need cadence alignment
- Compensation/legal checks (HR + payroll) required before public comms

Asks:
1) Can Hannah own timeline & communications with manager-level stakeholders?
2) Laura — can you confirm payroll/comp constraints and any notice requirements?
3) Soojin & Aditya — need exec alignment on director hire/slotting and whether we convert an open req or repurpose an existing role.

Appended a short transition playbook; I recommend a private manager-only briefing prior to any all-hands. Happy to walk through this in 30 minutes if helpful.

Thanks —
Marcus
Director, Serving Runtime

I'll block time tomorrow for a short exec alignment (30m). If Aditya is comfortable, we'll sign off on the timeline and then Hannah can start manager outreach.

Date: 2026-11-18 11:40 PST
Subject: Re: Line management consolidation: proposal & ask

Thanks — I can own manager communications and the transition checklist. Initial timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (private): manager 1:1s + HR flags (confidential)
- Week 1: manager briefing; align on messaging and one-off comp actions
- Week 2: managers cascade to direct reports; optional AMAs for wider team in week 3

Manager 1:1 script (summary):
- Explain rationale (clear career trajectory, reduced context switching)
- What changes day-to-day: reporting line, peer review panel, on-call rotations
- Reassure on role scope: no immediate role eliminations; any changes will have 1:1 review and support
- Next steps & timeline; point to HR contact for questions

Open items for leadership:
- Performance reviews: do we freeze review outcomes until after manager moves, or proceed and apply adjustments post-transition?
- Compensation: if a manager span increases and a market remediation is required, do we have budget already?

I attached a draft manager_comm_draft.docx (also in drive) with suggested phrasing and an FAQ. Happy to iterate.

— Hannah

Quick payroll/comp note:
- No statutory notice requirement beyond typical manager notification for US-based employees, but international teams may need local counsel review — flag: EU and APAC headcount moves require 30-day advance notices in some jurisdictions.
- If we change manager titles or reporting lines and this triggers comp band changes, payroll needs at least 2 full pay cycles to make adjustments cleanly.
- Please route any proposed comp increases through People Ops (people-ops@redwood.com) with a subject line referencing the transition and the affected employee ids.

Laura Bennett
Head of Total Rewards & Compliance

Thanks all — I support the consolidation directionally. A few governance points before we proceed broadly:
1) Director slot: prefer repurposing an existing open Director requisition (DIR-112) rather than posting a new role; this reduces hiring latency.
2) Performance reviews: proceed with the current cadence but hold calibration adjustments for two weeks until manager 1:1s are complete. We should avoid blocking promotions/raises — those can proceed with a note that org moves are in-flight.
3) Manager bandwidth: authorize a 0.25 FTE interim lead backfill for any manager expected to exceed target spans during the transition window. Finance to track budget to the transition project code.

Please run the private manager 1:1s this week. If no substantial objections, Soojin can send the manager comm and we can schedule the exec signoff on Friday.

Aditya Rao
Head of Product & Platform Strategy
